programme.title: The Simpsons - Sideshow Bob's Last Gleaming
programme.desc: Springfield's air show turns bad with the arrival of an atomic bomb-toting Sideshow Bob. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1995-11-26

programme.title: The Simpsons - The Simpsons 138th Episode Spectacular
programme.desc: Troy McClure hosts a brief history of the Simpsons that includes outtakes and never-seen-before footage. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1995-12-03

programme.title: Bob's Burgers - P.T.A. It Ain't So
programme.desc: Linda attempts to become more involved with the P.T.A.; Bob tries to cheer up a hardware store owner after unknowingly making a joke about his pet parrot that recently flew away. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2019-05-05

programme.title: Bob's Burgers - Yes Without My Zeke
programme.desc: When Zeke gets into trouble, the Belcher kids and Jimmy Jr. try to prevent him from being sent to a disciplinary school; Tina tries to thwart their mission, so she can have Jimmy Jr. to herself; Randy rents out Bob's Burgers to shoot a film. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2019-05-12

programme.title: Bob's Burgers - The Ring (But Not Scary)
programme.desc: Bob's plan to surprise Linda for their anniversary gets tricky when the kids become involved. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2019-09-29

programme.title: Bob's Burgers - Boys Just Wanna Have Fungus
programme.desc: Unable to afford a rare gourmet mushroom for a Burger of the Day, Bob and Gene jump into the cutthroat world of mushroom foraging; Tina's powerful new prescription glasses lead her to believe she has a superpower. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2019-10-06

programme.title: Bob's Burgers - Motor, She Boat
programme.desc: Tina and Bob participate in the Thundergirls father-daughter cardboard boat race; Tina tries to hide her feelings about Bob's terrible boat-building skills; Linda drags Louise and Gene to a fire station open house and overstays her welcome. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2019-10-13

programme.title: Bob's Burgers - Pig Trouble in Little Tina
programme.desc: Things get spooky when Tina dissects a pig in science class; Bob and Linda battle a giant ball of ear wax. (Animated, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2019-10-20

programme.title: Family Guy - Cat Fight
programme.desc: When Quagmire opens a cat café in town, Brian decides to take a stand to get the café shut down; when Meg and Brian get in trouble at school, Lois becomes nervous and decides they need to go to church camp to find their way. (Animated, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2019-11-03

programme.title: Family Guy - Peter & Lois' Wedding
programme.desc: The Wi-Fi goes out in the Griffin house, leaving the family with nothing to do for the evening; Peter and Lois decide to tell the kids the story of how they met and fell in love in the '90s. (Animated, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2019-11-10

programme.title: Family Guy - Heart Burn
programme.desc: In celebration of Peter and Lois' anniversary, the Griffins recount their own versions of three love stories. (Animated, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2019-11-17

programme.title: Family Guy - Shanksgiving
programme.desc: When Lois hosts a special Thanksgiving dinner for her family, Peter decides the best way to avoid it is to get arrested; a secret that Stewie has been keeping from everyone is revealed. (Animated, Holiday, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2019-11-24

programme.title: Family Guy - Christmas Is Coming
programme.desc: Meg has a response after she takes Stewie to the mall to meet Santa; Brian must help Stewie process the experience. (Animated, Holiday, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2019-12-15

programme.title: Family Guy - Connie's Celica
programme.desc: When Lois gets a job as the music teacher at Chris and Meg's school, a mean student decides to make Lois the target of her antics. (Animated, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2020-01-05

programme.title: Family Guy - Short Cuts
programme.desc: When Brian accidentally becomes a local hero, an old street pal reaches out and tries to convince him to get neutered; Lois gets a pixie cut against Peter's wishes, so Peter retaliates. (Animated, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2020-02-16

programme.title: Family Guy - Undergrounded
programme.desc: Peter secretly gets a credit card and overspends the family money, so Lois grounds him; to escape, Peter builds a tunnel leading directly to The Drunken Clam. (Animated, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2020-02-23

programme.title: Family Guy - Rich Old Stewie
programme.desc: Stewie's lush retirement is interrupted by Brian, who brings news that Peter is dying. (Animated, Sitcom, Comedy) - 2020-03-01

programme.title: Family Guy - The Movement

When he loses his sight at the age of 9, his hardworking mother (Sharon Warren) urges him not to feel sorry for himself. He rises through the ranks of the Seattle jazz scene, struggling with drug addiction and infidelity while on the road. Supported by his wife (Kerry Washington), Ray Charles redefines soul music and inspires a generation.
